pairing: all controller conditions and repetitions share an instance; inference clusters within instance
primary_analysis: family-specific; no pooled MRI/MRSI headline effect
direct_condition_rule: pre-observation assessment; prevention baseline only; excluded from post-observation recognition contrast

design_assumptions.derivation: normal approximation to paired binary difference; must be stress-tested by the statistical reviewer

independence_guard: each instance has a unique latent anatomy/field seed; difficulty variants of one latent seed may not count as separate units

missingness.provider_or_infrastructure_failure: retain in denominator and report separately; rerun only under a predeclared provider-failure rule
missingness.grader_or_leakage_defect: stop affected family, version deviation, repair before any restart

uncertainty: paired instance-cluster bootstrap with frozen seed plus exact paired sensitivity analysis
multiplicity: co-primary interpretation and any alpha allocation remain unresolved pending statistical signoff
cost_note: run count is a design target, not authorization to spend; perform a minimal discriminative checkout and freeze a separate aggregate cost ceiling first
